_scope: ONE node: Apply AI Analysis (replaces the whole jsCode shipped as 458db74f). No change to the prompt, the search queries, the location/position gates, the 50 threshold, enrichment, completion or billing.
_theDefect: The scorer shipped as 458db74f dropped every `neutral` criterion from the sum, so a criterion the recruiter SET but the profile says nothing about counted exactly like one the recruiter never set. A profile confirming only the position scored 100. Exec 2039: 10 of 20 evaluations (7 different people) scored 100; only one of those people had position, location, years and age all verified.
_theRule: A criterion the recruiter set earns the share of positive among the judgements that took a side (positive 1, warning 0), and 0.5 when the profile is silent on it (every insight neutral, or none at all); a neutral remark next to a real judgement adds nothing. Set = position and location always; years, age, notes, languages, skills, certifications, gender when non-blank and not the prompt's own unset markers ('not specified', 'none'). A criterion the recruiter did not set is not scored, whatever the model wrote. What was set is read from the Webhook body, never inferred from the insights. The 'other' 20% is the mean over the set sub-filters. A verdict on a combined label ('Gender and Age: ...') applies to every criterion it names - a positive means all match, a warning at worst that all fail; a separate judgement on one of them still counts and the share of positive decides. If no set criterion was judged positive or warning, the node falls back exactly as before (model score / none) - an unparseable answer can never come out at a bare 50. Exact halves round up regardless of floating-point error. Competencies are unchanged.
_labelMapping: Letters-only; bracketed qualifiers are removed BEFORE the label is cut at the first colon ('Required Skills (e.g.: Excel)' is skills, 'Location (final cap)' is location). position/location/years match by prefix ('positioning' excluded, so 'Positioning & Messaging' stays a competency); the other filters match an explicit list of spellings exactly, including the 'Required ...' and singular forms (a prefix like 'age' would claim 'Agency management'). `ageRange` was read as a competency by 458db74f; it is now age - but every real ageRange insight was neutral, and a neutral age earns the same half as an unmentioned one, so the remap changes no real score in the retained runs. Combined labels split only when EVERY part is a criterion ('Position and seniority' stays position; 'Territory & Location Planning' and 'Seniority and position' stay competencies).
_measuredBeforeWriting: Offline replay of all 19 retained runs (426 real evaluations, 2026-09-16..29), running the LIVE node code read from n8n (sha256 c88ec315, byte-identical to pending/headhunter-criteria-scoring.node.js) against this node. Fidelity: the live code reproduces the stored score for 20/20 evaluations of exec 2039. See _remeasuredAfterReview for the figures on the final code.
_openRisk: A candidate with only ONE of position/location confirmed, the other silent, the other set filters silent and competencies mostly warned can fall from ~70 to 46-49 and leave the shortlist (e.g. years+age set, position+, rest silent, all competencies warned: 70 -> 47; position silent, location+, years set, all competencies warned: 70 -> 48). Frequencies in the 426 retained evaluations: position judged only neutral in 25 (5.9%); location neutral in 6 of 432 location insights. Neither crossing occurred.
_otherSubCriteriaUntestedOnRealData: None of the 19 retained searches set languages, skills, certifications, gender or notes; those rules are covered by synthetic cases in the test only. The model judged an UNSET filter 3 times in 426 evaluations, all positive (languages and skills in exec 1869, languages in exec 2039); it never judged years in a search without a years filter (0 of 231).
_notScored: company: the filter was removed on 2026-09-28 and is no longer sent. industryType: the backend sends it and the form offers it, but the prompt never asks the model to judge industry (it appears only inside the 'options:' summary line), so scoring it would give every candidate a silent half on a question nobody asked (independent review, reproduced: 100 -> 88 on the same judgements). 458db74f never scored industry as a criterion either; it read a judged 'Industry:' line as a COMPETENCY, while this node recognises the label and ignores it. No industry line was judged in the retained runs, so no real score is affected. FOLLOW-UP for the owner: add an industryType line to the prompt, then score it here in the same change.
_delivery: 0 of 426 evaluations cross the 50 line, and every one of the 19 retained searches has evaluations at 50 or above both before and after (fewest: 4, exec 2035), so the last-resort 45/40 cascade never engages there. Hence the phase-1 shortlist (Finalize Top N Send sends everyone >= 50, no cut) and the NUMBER delivered are unchanged. Finalize Phase 2 Send fills its shortfall in score order, so WHO fills a phase-2 shortfall can change - by design: a verified candidate now outranks one the profile is silent about. In a search where nobody reaches 40, phase 1 sends (and bills, 6 credits each) EVERYONE left in the pool (Accumulate keeps >= 25), and phase 2 the best of it up to the shortfall; that pool can now include a candidate at 27 (position silent, location warning) who scored 0 before. Pre-existing cascade policy, not changed here - owner's call.
_review: Two independent read-only review rounds, every medium+ finding sent to a skeptic. Round 1 (integration, adversarial inputs, claims audit, test adequacy): industryType scored but never asked (confirmed by all four lenses) - fixed by not scoring it; low findings acted on: neutral next to a judgement, bracketed/variant labels, 'Positioning', the prompt's unset markers, delivery wording, the ageRange cause attribution, a false claim about years (0 of 231), surviving mutants. Round 2 (break the revisions, claims audit): no medium+ finding survived verification except the mutation-list overstatement; acted on: the round-1 'combined verdict = silent' rule scored outside every reading of the verdict (could shortlist a candidate the model flagged, 59 vs <50 for every attribution) - replaced by 'applies to every criterion it names'; missing 'Required certifications'/singular spellings; brackets containing a colon; exact-half rounding; wording and dates.
_remeasuredAfterReview: Final code (executable part, comments stripped, canonical sha256 7414ced6 on both machines) replayed on all 426 retained evaluations against the live node: 120 scores change (50 down, 70 up); 0 cross 50 in either direction; 29 / 10 / 9 rise past 25 / 40 / 45; fallbacks 1 -> 1. All 120 changes involve a set criterion the profile is silent on. The review fixes change no real score: a neutral next to a judgement on the same criterion occurs 0 times in the 426, no retained search set an optional filter, no combined label covered two set criteria, and every real ageRange insight was neutral.
